paras: Right-angle parallel projection of three planes is the basis of all technical drawing. It is best demonstrated with an open cube or a dimensional corner so that students can determine the form of the object. The procedure can be reversed: from two given projections of the same object the third must be found.

These photographs of a model with movable planes demonstrate three-part projection. The shapes and dimensional features of the model can be prepared with wires. The turned position in front of a vertical glass plate is used to explain central projection: the appropriate threads are drawn through previously determined penetration points in the glass plate to produce the perspective picture.
